wholePhysicalScope: Hotel way 23866797, connected entrance and northwest wing, and mapped tower and turret parts establish the modeled exterior. The H-plan has two deep open forecourts and lower attached ranges.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the full hotel footprint, open forecourts, attached ranges, twin tower crowns and eight turrets. Near levels refine the cream trim, windows and entrance arcades.
limitations: October 2007 exterior, corroborated by a January 2006 oblique view. Main footprints and roof tower positions are mapped; heights and detailed window divisions are estimated.
The courtyard and perimeter use the original elevation source. Entrance thresholds, service areas and terrace elevations remain approximate.
Garden structures, interior rooms, vehicles and later decorations are outside the model.
